versions.content: The Dem module shall provide a buffer mechanism to queue events which are reported before Dem_Init via Dem_SetEventStatus as qual- ified as Passed or Failed or reaching the qualification (debouncing). Reporting of DEM_EVENT_STATUS_FDC_THRESHOLD_REACHED shall not be queued.
